panels.title: Read-only local security monitoring / policy settings

options.content:
**Match both selectors to the running app:** dev = 30 / 30 seconds, default = 300 / 300. Selectors do not change application settings. Fixed last 5 minutes is a separate statistic. R-01 = 5 denials across 3 distinct pseudonymized accounts.

Suppression is inferred from persisted state, not a count of skipped runs. An eligible candidate does not guarantee scheduler execution. No automatic blocking or Grafana alert engine. Charts/tables are limited to the selected range / last 24h; live panels always use DB now.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE result='ALLOWED') AS allowed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE result='DENIED') AS denied FROM audit_event WHERE occurred_at >= GREATEST(to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AND occurred_at <= LEAST(to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), statement_timestamp());

SELECT date_trunc('minute',occurred_at) AS time, result, count(*) AS requests FROM audit_event WHERE occurred_at >= GREATEST(to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AND occurred_at <= LEAST(to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

SELECT reason_code,action,count(*) AS requests FROM audit_event WHERE occurred_at >= GREATEST(to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AND occurred_at <= LEAST(to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()) AND result='DENIED' GROUP BY reason_code,action ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 30;

panels.title: R-01 policy candidates / inferred suppression (DB now)
panels.description: Match selectors to application settings. Read-only estimate; not a count of suppressed executions and not a scheduler-health check.

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (SELECT statement_timestamp() AS t,
  ${window_seconds:sqlstring}::integer AS window_seconds,
  ${cooldown_seconds:sqlstring}::integer AS cooldown_seconds),
c AS (SELECT principal_type,principal_id,count(*)::integer AS violation_count,
 count(DISTINCT resource_ref)::integer AS distinct_resource_count
 FROM audit_event CROSS JOIN p WHERE occurred_at>p.t-p.window_seconds*interval '1 second'
 AND occurred_at<=p.t AND principal_type IN ('CUSTOMER','PARTNER') AND principal_id IS NOT NULL
AND result='DENIED' AND reason_code='OBJECT_ACCESS_DENIED'
AND action IN ('ACCOUNT_READ','TRANSACTION_READ','GRANT_CREATE','GRANT_REVOKE') AND resource_ref IS NOT NULL GROUP BY principal_type,principal_id),
k AS (SELECT principal_type,principal_id FROM c UNION
 SELECT principal_type,principal_id FROM detection_state WHERE rule_id='R-01')
SELECT k.principal_type,k.principal_id,p.t AS evaluated_at,p.window_seconds,p.cooldown_seconds,
 COALESCE(c.violation_count,0) AS violation_count,COALESCE(c.distinct_resource_count,0) AS distinct_resource_count,
 COALESCE(c.violation_count>=5 AND c.distinct_resource_count>=3,false) AS threshold_met,
 s.last_alert_at,s.last_window_end,s.last_alert_at+p.cooldown_seconds*interval '1 second' AS suppression_until,
 CASE WHEN s.last_alert_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ceil(GREATEST(0,extract(epoch FROM
 s.last_alert_at+p.cooldown_seconds*interval '1 second'-p.t)))::integer END AS remaining_seconds,
 CASE WHEN s.last_alert_at IS NULL THEN 'NO_PREVIOUS_ALERT'
 WHEN p.t<s.last_alert_at+p.cooldown_seconds*interval '1 second' THEN 'SUPPRESSED'
 WHEN p.t<=s.last_window_end THEN 'STALE_WINDOW'
 WHEN COALESCE(c.violation_count>=5 AND c.distinct_resource_count>=3,false) THEN 'ELIGIBLE_NOT_A_GUARANTEE'
 ELSE 'CONDITIONS_NOT_MET' END AS suppression_status
FROM k CROSS JOIN p LEFT JOIN c USING(principal_type,principal_id)
LEFT JOIN detection_state s ON s.rule_id='R-01' AND s.principal_type=k.principal_type AND s.principal_id=k.principal_id
ORDER BY k.principal_type,k.principal_id LIMIT 100;

panels.title: R-01 persisted alerts / observed window and gap
panels.description: Gap uses alerts inside the selected/max24h range; first row per principal has no prior gap. Window match does not prove cooldown configuration.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (SELECT *,detected_at-lag(detected_at) OVER
 (PARTITION BY rule_id,principal_type,principal_id ORDER BY detected_at,id) AS alert_gap
 FROM security_alert WHERE rule_id='R-01' AND detected_at>=GREATEST(to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0),statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours')
 AND detected_at<=LEAST(to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0),statement_timestamp()))
SELECT principal_type,principal_id,rule_id,violation_count,distinct_resource_count,window_start,window_end,
 extract(epoch FROM window_end-window_start)::integer AS observed_window_seconds,
 window_end-window_start=(${window_seconds:sqlstring}::integer*interval '1 second') AS matches_selected_window,
 detected_at,extract(epoch FROM alert_gap) AS alert_gap_seconds
FROM a ORDER BY detected_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Recent audit / request IDs (selected range, max 24h)

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at,principal_type,principal_id,action,result,reason_code,resource_ref,request_id FROM audit_event WHERE occurred_at >= GREATEST(to_timestamp(${__from}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()-interval '24 hours') AND occurred_at <= LEAST(to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0), statement_timestamp()) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 200;
